Сетка — это много лимитных заявок сразу:: A grid is many limit orders at once: buys below the price and sells above. The range is divided by levels into cells; each cell buys at its lower level and sells at its upper one, and each such pair of trades is a "round trip" with a small profit. While the price moves within the range, round trips accumulate. When the price goes down, the grid ends up all in the coin and loses with it; when up, all in money and misses the rise. That is why it is important to look not only at round-trip profit but also at the revaluation of the coins the grid holds.
